construction: Lossless decompression of the accepted exact 48-class pair map: each serialized pair_class_id selects the exact class branch_count, branch_code and branch_amplitude. No new physical approximation is introduced.
scope: Exact SU(2) second neutral magnetic Krylov connected-pair payload. This remains a preconditioner/component; it is not the full charged U_cone, not a lambda=1 Riesz/Kato state, not C9^(6), and not G2.
